question: ______ is a Hindustani classical musician who plays the bowed instrument, the sarangi.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pandit Ram Narayan.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pandit Ram Narayan** is a **Hindustani classical musician** who plays the bowed instrument, the** sarangi.**
 
• He was born on **December 25, 1927,** in **Udaipur, **Rajasthan.
 
• He is a recipient of various prestigious awards including **Padma Bhushan and Padma Vibhushan.**
 
• Pandit Ram Narayan has been instrumental in popularizing the** sarangi as a solo instrument.**
 
• He has collaborated with various renowned musicians such as** Ravi Shankar and Zakir Hussain.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sandeep Das** is a **tabla player** who has collaborated with** Yo-Yo Ma **and the **Silk Road Ensemble.**
 
• **Zakir Hussain** is a **tabla player and composer** who has collaborated with various renowned musicians such as J**ohn McLaughlin, Mickey Hart, and George Harrison.**
 
• **Shiv Kumar Sharma** is a **santoor player** who is known for introducing the** santoor to Hindustani classical music.**
 
• **Pandit Ram Narayan's contributions **to the world of music have been recognized by various institutions such as **Sangeet Natak Akademi **and the Indian government.
